data.name: Bheem
data.gender_notes: Bheem is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bheem is a name derived from Sanskrit language, meaning strong and valiant. It is the name of one of the central characters in the Indian epic Mahabharata, known for his immense strength and courage. The name Bheem carries the meaning “Strong, Valiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bheem usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Bheem belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Valiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bheem total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_sanskrit.name: Bheem
in_sanskrit.meaning: The Roaring One, The Terror, The Terrible One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Bheem is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhima', which means 'roaring', 'terrifying', or 'terrible'. He is also known as Bhima-Vibhishana, meaning 'the one who vanquishes the fearsome one'.
